editorial:
Get ready for a night of total chaos and huge hits. You get to see a massive grudge match where Mark Henry tries to crush John Cena after pretending to retire just to lure him in. It is a classic David versus Goliath story, but with way more punching. Beyond that, you have Dolph Ziggler fighting for a title and a wild ladder match featuring Rob Van Dam. The whole vibe is loud, energetic, and feels like a giant party where anyone could get knocked out at any second.

What really pops is the speed of the action. The ladder match is a highlight because it keeps you on the edge of your seat wondering who will actually climb to the top. While some of the drama feels a bit over the top, that is exactly why you watch wrestling. If you love high-energy fights and big personalities, you will have a blast. You should definitely check this out by streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep in your physical collection for those movie nights with friends.
endingExplained: The night ends with some huge wins and losses. John Cena manages to beat Mark Henry in a tough fight to keep his title. In the big ladder match, the chaos settles when a winner finally grabs the briefcase, giving them a shot at the championship whenever they want. The show wraps up with a mix of revenge and glory, leaving you wondering who will use that briefcase first in the coming weeks.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves professional wrestling and big fights.
